PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM_POWER.title: Unrelenting Form
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM_POWER.description: Once per turn, when you reach 2 or fewer cards in Hand, draw 2 cards and gain Energy.
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM_POWER.smartDescri: Once per turn, when you reach 2 or fewer cards in [gold]Hand[/gold], draw 2 cards and gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Energy.
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW_POWER.title: Hammer Throw
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW_POWER.descriptio: Whenever a card is Retained, deal damage to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW_POWER.smartDescr: Whenever a card is [gold]Retained[/gold], deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-FROSTBITE_POWER.title: Frostbite
PACKMASTER-FROSTBITE_POWER.description: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Frostbite and halves it. Whenever it receives attack damage, apply 1 Frostbite.
PACKMASTER-FROSTBITE_POWER.smartDescript: At the start of its turn, loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP and this is halved. Whenever this creature receives attack damage, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
PACKMASTER-FRIGID_BODY_POWER.title: Frigid Body
PACKMASTER-FRIGID_BODY_POWER.description: Whenever you are attacked, apply Frostbite equal to blocked damage.
PACKMASTER-FRIGID_BODY_POWER.smartDescri: For [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}, whenever you are attacked, apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] equal to blocked damage received.
PACKMASTER-FROSTED_EDGE_POWER.title: Frosted Edge
PACKMASTER-FROSTED_EDGE_POWER.descriptio: Whenever you apply Frostbite, gain temporary Strength.
PACKMASTER-ICE_SHATTER_POWER.title: Ice Shatter
PACKMASTER-ICE_SHATTER_POWER.description: Whenever this enemy loses HP during their next turn, deal damage.
PACKMASTER-ICE_SHATTER_POWER.smartDescri: Whenever this enemy loses HP during their next turn, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage.
PACKMASTER-SNOWED_IN_POWER.title: Snowed In
PACKMASTER-SNOWED_IN_POWER.description: This enemy's Frostbite is not halved.
PACKMASTER-SNOWED_IN_POWER.smartDescript: This enemy's [gold]Frostbite[/gold] is not halved for [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}.
